title: Turning Technician on grants no access
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a custom role made for this test, role A, with no access to Work Orders, so staff member A has no Work Orders access before or after.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on role A, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, who can sign in.
custom_steps:
1. Sign out.
  2. Sign in as staff member A.
  3. Type the Work Orders address in the browser's address bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • You are signed out.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A is signed in.
  • The menu offers no Work Orders, as before.

Step 3:

  • Work Orders does not open for staff member A, as before: Technician gave no access.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Technician grants no access.”
  • Out of Scope: “Who can see or edit work. Technician grants no access to anything. It only decides who is offered as a technician.”
